final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS avg_across_ratings FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_above_average, AVG(p.avg_per_day - o.avg_across_ratings) AS avg_excess FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_per_day > o.avg_across_ratings
